title: How Long Does a Letter Take in Canada?
description: Canada Post's Lettermail standards are 2 business days locally, 3 provincially and 4 nationally. They are estimates, not guarantees.
keywords: how long does a letter take in canada
answer: Canada Post's Lettermail delivery standards are two business days within a city, three within a province and four across the country, not counting the day of mailing. They are estimates, not guarantees. A letter sent through a mailing service also needs a day or so to be printed and posted.

blocks.p: Business days exclude the day of mailing. Canada Post states that delivery standards are estimates and are not guaranteed.

If you mail the letter yourself, the clock starts when it enters the postal system. If a service prints and posts it, add its processing time. sendletter prints and mails an order within one business day of payment, so at Canada Post's national standard a letter lands about five business days after you order. Canada Post's standards are estimates, not guarantees.
Allow extra time around holidays and in rural or remote areas. Ordinary Lettermail has no tracking, so you will not see it move.

Because ordinary Lettermail is not guaranteed and not tracked, it is a poor fit for a deadline. Mail early, or use a service with tracking. [Registered Mail versus regular mail](/blog/registered-vs-regular-mail-canada) covers what each provides.
